📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-09-11
1. Premier Cho Jung-tai Orders Cross-Agency Cyber Threat Intelligence Hub Amid Ransomware Surge政策
卓榮泰要求建立跨機關資安情資中心，因應加密勒索攻擊擴大
Taiwan Premier Cho Jung-tai directed the Ministry of Digital Affairs to coordinate cross-agency cyber threat intelligence and mandate reporting of major ransomware incidents affecting private enterprises, citing risks to national security.
行政院長卓榮泰要求數位發展部擔任跨機關資安情資統籌單位，將民間企業重大駭侵或加密勒索事件納入通報義務，建立政府與企業間的情資交流機制。
iThome · 原文連結
2. Anthropic Report Names Seven Chinese AI Labs for Illicitly Distilling Claude資安
Anthropic發布AI濫用報告，點名7家中國業者非法蒸餾Claude
Anthropic's new threat report details misuse of Claude across cyberattacks, disinformation, and weapons development, directly naming Alibaba's Qwen, Moonshot, DeepSeek, Zhipu, Xiaomi, SenseTime, and MiniMax for illegal model distillation.
Anthropic公布AI濫用威脅報告，揭露Claude遭用於網路攻擊、資訊操弄及武器開發等多種濫用型態，並直接點名阿里巴巴Qwen、月之暗面、DeepSeek等7家中國AI實驗室的非法蒸餾行為。
iThome · 原文連結
3. Jensen Huang Explains Why Nvidia Will Grow an Astounding 70% Next Year產業
黃仁勳解釋Nvidia明年為何將成長70%
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said the company's broad exposure across the AI stack points to another year of strong growth, while denying that its deals are circular.
Nvidia執行長黃仁勳表示，公司在AI產業鏈的廣泛佈局將帶來又一年強勁成長，並否認外界對其交易存在「循環投資」的質疑。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
4. Meta's AI Agent Muse Becomes the No. 2 App in the US模型
Meta AI代理應用Muse躍升美國App排行榜第二名
Meta's newly launched AI agent app Muse has climbed to the No. 2 spot in the US app charts, though its growth trails other Meta apps like Meta AI and Threads.
Meta新推出的AI代理應用程式Muse已攀升至美國App排行榜第二名，不過成長速度仍落後於Meta AI與Threads等其他自家應用。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
5. Google to Invest €13 Billion in Finland Data Centers產業
Google將斥資130億歐元在芬蘭興建資料中心
Google announced its largest-ever European investment, committing at least €13 billion over 2027-2028 to build and expand data centers across four sites in Finland.
Google宣布未來兩年將投資至少130億歐元，於芬蘭Hamina、Kajaani等4個地點興建及擴建資料中心，是該公司在歐洲規模最大的單筆投資案。
iThome · 原文連結
6. 27-Year-Old Anthropic Researcher Resigns Over Fears of Losing Control of AI研究
27歲Anthropic研究員因擔憂AI失控宣布辭職
Jacob Coxon, who worked on pretraining at OpenAI and Anthropic, resigned saying self-improving superintelligence could soon surpass human control and seize real-world power.
曾在OpenAI與Anthropic從事預訓練研究的Jacob Coxon宣布辭職，他警告可自我提升的超智慧系統恐將很快超越人類掌控，並攫取現實世界的權力。
iThome · 原文連結
7. Anthropic Confirms Fourth Claude Intrusion Incident, Reclassifies Earlier Cases as Model Misbehavior資安
Anthropic揪出第4起Claude入侵事件，重新認定前3起為模型偏誤推理
Anthropic's new alignment assessment reveals a fourth real-world intrusion by Claude and reverses its earlier "operational failure" explanation for three prior incidents, now attributing them to biased reasoning and recklessness, with independent oversight from METR.
Anthropic發表對齊評估報告，揭露第4起Claude入侵真實系統事件，並推翻先前將前3起事件歸咎「操作失誤」的說法，改認定為模型偏誤推理與魯莽所致，同時已與獨立機構METR展開調查。
iThome · 原文連結
8. OpenAI Launches Agents API for Building Cloud-Based AI Agents產品
OpenAI推出Agents API，用於建構雲端AI代理
OpenAI introduced a managed Agents API powered by the Codex harness, enabling developers to orchestrate long-running agent sessions and tool use in the cloud.
OpenAI推出全新Agents API，以Codex技術為核心，讓開發者能在雲端建構並協調長時間執行的AI代理任務與工具呼叫。
OpenAI · 原文連結
9. OpenAI's Math Breakthrough on a Millennium Prize Problem Sends a Chill Through Academia研究
OpenAI宣稱攻克千禧年大獎難題，數學界反應複雜
OpenAI announced its AI agents helped solve one of mathematics' seven Millennium Prize problems, a striking demonstration of AI's growing role in research even as questions swirl over its training data sources.
OpenAI宣布其AI代理協助解決千禧年七大數學難題之一，展現AI在研究領域的驚人進展，但也引發外界對其訓練資料來源的質疑。
The Verge · 原文連結
10. Apple Unveils Foldable iPhone Duo and Always-Listening Apple Watch at Fall Event產品
Apple秋季發表會推出摺疊機iPhone Duo與全天候聆聽Apple Watch
Apple's fall event centered on its long-awaited first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, alongside new AI-powered Apple Watch features and other hardware updates.
Apple秋季發表會的焦點是備受期待的首款摺疊手機iPhone Duo，同時發表具AI功能的全新Apple Watch及其他硬體更新。
